item.title: Cost of Living in Cranbourne Melbourne
item.description:
Money matters when you’re choosing where to live. Here’s the real story on costs in Cranbourne — no sugar-coating, no made-up figures.

Read our full Cranbourne suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Cranbourne Expensive?

Cranbourne sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Cranbourne, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Cranbourne — History and How It's Changed
item.description:

What Cranbourne Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Cranbourne was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.
